about: Every external dataset DORA may download, with pins, licence and credit. Read by tools/ext_data.py (fetch, check, ATTRIBUTIONS.md) and by the gate-30/34 tests. tier core = the default fetch; full = only with --full or by name. use train = the licence allows training a model DORA ships (CC-BY-4.0 or CC0-1.0); eval-only = benchmark only. Sizes and MD5s are Zenodo's; SHA-256s are pinned from downloads whose MD5 matched (null = not downloaded yet, so the first fetch prints it for pinning).

datasets.name: deepbacs-mreb
datasets.title: DeepBacs: Escherichia coli MreB denoising dataset
datasets.citation: Spahn et al., "DeepBacs for multi-task bacterial image analysis using open-source deep learning approaches", Communications Biology 5, 688 (2022)
datasets.content: E. coli MreB-sfGFP, live cells; 2D noisy/clean pairs, 16-bit 512x512; 30 train, 5 test

datasets.name: mdc25-tribolium

datasets.content: 15,500 paired 3D training patches (16 z-slices of 64x64, float32), noisy/ and gt/ by file name

datasets.name: mdc25-planaria

datasets.name: fmd
datasets.creators: Yide Zhang, Yinhao Zhu, Evan Nichols, Qingfei Wang, Siyuan Zhang, Cody Smith, Scott Howard
datasets.title: Fluorescence Microscopy Denoising (FMD) dataset
datasets.citation: Zhang et al., "A Poisson-Gaussian Denoising Dataset with Real Fluorescence Microscopy Images", CVPR 2019 (arXiv:1812.10366)
datasets.content: confocal, two-photon and widefield, 12 categories plus the test_mix benchmark; 5 noise levels with averaged references

datasets.name: aydin-egg-chamber
datasets.creators: Loic A. Royer, Ahmet Can Solak (Aydin examples); original data: Machado et al.

datasets.citation: Machado, Mercier & Chiaruttini, "LimeSeg: a coarse-grained lipid membrane simulation for 3D image segmentation", BMC Bioinformatics 20, 2 (2019)
datasets.content: one file of the record, the only one used: a cropped point-scanning confocal volume of a Drosophila egg chamber, 164x128x128 (ZYX), uint16, no ground truth; CC BY 4.0 per the record's own file list (the record as a whole stays excluded below). For the wild-data check before brick 41

datasets.name: zerocost-n2v-3d
datasets.title: ZeroCostDL4Mic - Noise2Void (3D) example training and test dataset
datasets.citation: von Chamier et al., "Democratising deep learning for microscopy with ZeroCostDL4Mic", Nature Communications 12, 2276 (2021)

datasets.name: bbbc039
datasets.creators: Broad Bioimage Benchmark Collection (BBBC039); repackaged in CellBinDB by Shi et al.
datasets.title: BBBC039 (Hoechst-stained nuclei, high-throughput widefield), the copy in CellBinDB
datasets.citation: Caicedo et al., "Evaluation of Deep Learning Strategies for Nucleus Segmentation in Fluorescence Images", Cytometry Part A 95, 952-965 (2019); Ljosa, Sokolnicki & Carpenter, Nature Methods 9, 637 (2012)
datasets.content: BBBC039 from the CellBinDB record (the canonical Broad host is blocked here); CC0 1.0 per that record's mixed_licenses.txt and the Broad; widefield nuclei, no denoising ground truth; for the wild-data check before brick 41

excluded.name: aydin-examples
excluded.reason: the record is CC BY 4.0, but its file list gives per-file terms (CC BY-SA 4.0 for the OpenCell volumes, 'PI-confirmed redistribution' for several others), and its TIFFs are zstd-compressed, which DORA's reader doesn't decode
